# Agent rules — SuperLuxCore

**DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE.** It is injected as always-on context in every
agent session, so it is kept minimal on purpose. Documentation does NOT
belong here — write it in a standalone doc instead:

- `doc/features/<feature>.md` — feature docs (index: `doc/features/README.md`)
- `doc/engineering/<topic>.md` — implementation notes, debugging
  findings, platform gotchas (index: `doc/engineering/README.md`)
- `../dev-tools/SESSION_LOG.md` — running session log (workspace dev-tools)

Only workflow rules that must hold in *every* session may be added here,
by the maintainer. Keep this file under ~40 lines.

## Build / test quick reference

- Release module: `ninja -C out/build -f build-Release.ninja pysuperluxcore`
  (`ninja -C out/build pysuperluxcore` builds Debug only — multi-config).
- Regressions: `dev-tools/parity-regression.sh`, plus per-feature
  `dev-tools/e*_test.py` scripts (indexed in the docs above).
